# MRF Paints

> > India's premium paint brand offering innovative interior and exterior wall coatings with eco-certified, water-based formulations across multiple product lines.

MRF Paints is a leading paint manufacturer in India specializing in premium interior and exterior wall paints, primers, and eco-friendly coatings. The product portfolio includes established brands like Altura, AquaFresh, RUCA, Visa, and Campus with comprehensive color options and performance warranties.

## Key Topics

- Altura 2-in-1 Acrylic Emulsion
- AquaFresh PU Paint
- RUCA Luxury Emulsion
- Water-based Paint
- Eco-certified (GreenPro)
- Interior Wall Paint
- Exterior Wall Paint
- Wall Primer
- Acrylic Emulsion
- Budget Paint
- Interior-Exterior Coverage
- Surface Preparation
- Product Specifications
- Application Guide
- Washable Paint
